name: TOPGLOV
recent: Top Glove 在 2026 财年末季（截至 8 月 31 日）交出营收 12.48 亿令吉、净利 1.576 亿令吉的业绩，营收环比增长 14.0%，净利环比大增 94.6%。公司宣布每股 1.50 仙的免税终期股息，除息日为 11 月 23 日，派发日为 12 月 15 日。此外，雇员公积金局（KWAP）在 10 月密集申报股权变动，公司也因雇员认股计划（ESOS）和凭单转换而多次新增上市股份。
notable: 宣布每股 1.50 仙的免税终期股息，除息日为 2026 年 11 月 23 日，派发日为 2026 年 12 月 15 日。
雇员公积金局（KWAP）在 10 月多次申报股权变动。
因雇员认股计划（ESOS）及凭单转换，公司多次新增上市股份。
risks: 执行主席 Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai 在闭市期（closed period）内表示有意进行证券交易。
雇员公积金局（KWAP）在 10 月多次申报股权变动，显示大股东持股出现调整。
earnings: 2026 财年末季（截至 8 月 31 日）营收为 12.48 亿令吉，环比增长 14.0%，同比增长 39.7%；净利为 1.576 亿令吉，环比增长 94.6%，同比增长 352.6%；净利率为 12.6%，高于上一季度的 7.4%。

recent_en: Top Glove reported revenue of RM1.248 billion and net profit of RM157.6 million for the final quarter of FY2026 ended 31 August, with revenue up 14.0% QoQ and net profit up 94.6% QoQ. The company declared a tax-exempt final dividend of 1.50 sen per share, with ex-date on 23 November and payment date on 15 December. In addition, KWAP filed numerous changes in substantial shareholder interest in October, and the company made several additional listings of shares arising from ESOS and warrant conversions.
notable_en: Declared a tax-exempt final dividend of 1.50 sen per share, with ex-date on 23 November 2026 and payment date on 15 December 2026.
KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest during October.
The company made several additional listings of shares arising from ESOS and warrant conversions.
risks_en: Executive Chairman Tan Sri Dr Lim Wee Chai indicated intention to deal in securities during the closed period.
KWAP filed multiple changes in substantial shareholder interest in October, indicating adjustments in major shareholder holdings.
earnings_en: For the final quarter of FY2026 ended 31 August, revenue was RM1.248 billion, up 14.0% QoQ and 39.7% YoY; net profit was RM157.6 million, up 94.6% QoQ and 352.6% YoY; net margin was 12.6%, higher than 7.4% in the previous quarter.
